name: Banned | 200mg Hash Rosin Gummies | Watermelon
description: Savor the extraordinary pleasure of THC-infused hash rosin gummies, meticulously crafted through small-batch, chef-led expertise. These gourmet delights unveil a symphony of sensations with a harmonious two-tone explosion of flavors – a perfect marriage of refreshingly chewy and delicately tart. Adorned in an iconic array of vibrant colors reflecting their rich taste, each gummy is a masterpiece that transcends ordinary indulgence. With a sweet yet sparkling sour sugar coating, every bite becomes a captivating experience. Immerse yourself in the allure of a perfectly ripe watermelon flavor, where the sweet juiciness orchestrates a delightful tune on your taste buds. The burst of refreshing, mouthwatering deliciousness transports you to a heavenly tropical oasis, creating a delectable and crisp reminder of endless summery delights in every moment.
